text: Press A three times to stop the reels. Line up three of a kind on the middle row!

My husband's berries are the best. Have one of my favorites, too.
You solved my puzzle!

Your creatures fight on their own, as their nature tells them.

Every facility uses level-50 creatures. Legendaries can't enter.
